retrievalProfile.description: A high-energy urban collage featuring a central figure with a megaphone, surrounded by a radial sunburst of performers and arched, bold typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A dynamic, multi-layered composition centered on a crouching figure holding a megaphone, framed by a dense crowd of performers that radiate outward. The background features a vibrant yellow sunburst with radiating lines, all contained within a thick, magenta-to-purple gradient border. Arched text follows the curve of the sunburst, while secondary text is housed in banners at the top and bottom.
coreVisualRelationships: Radial symmetry centered on the primary subject's head
Arched typography mirroring the circular frame of the sunburst
High-contrast black and white photography against a saturated color palette
Layered depth with performers overlapping the background rays
coreInvariants: A central figure holding a megaphone as the primary anchor
A vibrant yellow radial sunburst background
A thick, saturated magenta or purple outer border frame
Arched display typography following the top curve of the central circle

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Primary subject is large and centered in the lower foreground; secondary subjects are smaller and arranged in a semi-circle around the center.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central figure's face and the white megaphone create the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the central figure, move upward along the radial lines to the arched title, then follow the circular border to the bottom banner.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the composition is dense and 'packed' to convey energy and a crowd atmosphere.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Vibrant Yellow (background sunburst and bottom banner)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Magenta/Purple (outer border and primary title text)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the borders and background creates a 'pop' effect against the desaturated or monochromatic photography of the subjects.
paletteRestrictions: Maintain high contrast between text and background

letterConstructionRules: Arched baseline for the main title
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are slightly sheared or rotated to follow the radial arc

composition.relationshipToImage: frames the top of the central crowd

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Pair a heavy arched display sans-serif with a smaller, condensed sans-serif for metadata and secondary banners.
graphicDevices: Halftone dot patterns in the background

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight and vertical presence for the blocky title.
Offers a classic urban/newsprint feel that matches the collage aesthetic.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a vibrant yellow radial sunburst with magenta borders. Place a central figure in a tan jacket holding a megaphone, surrounded by a semi-circle of diverse people in black and white photography style.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply bold, magenta, arched uppercase sans-serif text along the top curve of the sunburst. Add a yellow banner at the bottom with red uppercase text.

verificationChecks: Is the megaphone clearly visible in the foreground?
Does the color palette feature high-saturation magenta and yellow?
Are the secondary figures arranged radially?

mustRedesign: Do not replicate the 'Parental Advisory' logo
Ensure all text is original and not copied from the source
postGenerationChecks: Check that the text follows the curve of the sunburst accurately.
Verify that the central figure is the largest element in the composition.
Ensure the magenta border is thick and frames the entire image.
Confirm the background sunburst rays originate from the center.
recipe.reuseFormula: Radial Sunburst + Arched Heavy Sans-Serif + Urban Collage + Magenta/Yellow Palette
